headline: Maximize Daily Productivity with Practical AI Utilities
intro: Discover simple ways to integrate AI utilities into your daily workflow to streamline tasks and boost efficiency.
ideas: Automate routine email responses using smart text expansion prompts.
Summarize lengthy research articles and meeting transcripts in seconds.
Generate initial code boilerplate or debug syntax errors faster.
Create quick social media captions and outline blog posts.
Organize and categorize unstructured notes into actionable task lists.
tips: Provide clear context and role definitions in your prompts for better accuracy.
Always double-check AI outputs for facts, numbers, and logical consistency.
Iterate on your prompts by refining constraints rather than starting from scratch.
